notices.title: Staff meeting: lesson plans and assessment calendar
body: All teaching staff are requested to attend a meeting in the staff room on {date:-14} at 2:30 PM, after the last period.

Agenda:
1. Lesson plan submissions for the coming month
2. Assessment calendar and invigilation duties
3. Remedial classes for students who need extra support
Class teachers should bring their attendance registers. Please be seated by 2:25 PM.

notices.title: Revised school timings
body: From {date:-6}, school will begin at 8:15 AM and close at 2:15 PM for all classes. The main gate closes at 8:10 AM.
School buses will leave every stop 15 minutes earlier than at present. Bus attendants will share the revised pick-up times with parents.
Students who arrive late should report to the school office with a note from a parent.

notices.title: Science exhibition: models and group lists
body: The school science exhibition will be held on {date:+9} in the assembly hall, from 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM.
Students of the classes this notice is addressed to will present working models in groups of three. Each group chooses one topic from the list on the class notice board.
Group lists and topics must reach the class teacher by {date:+2}. Teachers on duty will receive the stall plan separately.
Parents are welcome to visit between 11:00 AM and 12:30 PM.

notices.title: Annual Sports Day invitation
body: .invite .head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5mm; padding-bottom: 5mm; border-bottom: 2px solid #1d4ed8; }
.invite h2 { margin: 9mm 0 2mm; font-size: 26px; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
.invite th, .invite td { padding: 2.5mm 3mm; border: 1px solid #cbd2d9; text-align: left; font-size: 13px; }
Students, parents and staff are warmly invited.
Reporting time8:00 AM for students, in house uniform
ProgrammeMarch past at 8:30 AM, track and field events from 9:00 AM, prize distribution at 12:30 PM
Students taking part in track events should carry a water bottle and a cap. Refreshments will be served to every student after the prize distribution.
Parents are requested to be seated by 8:20 AM. There are no classes on the day; school buses run at the usual morning time and return at 1:30 PM.

notices.title: Holiday homework guidelines
body: Subject teachers are requested to plan holiday homework that a student can finish in about thirty minutes a day.
Please prefer reading, a short project or revision worksheets over copying exercises, and share the homework with the class teacher by {date:+5}.
Class teachers will combine the subjects into one sheet per class before it is sent home.

notices.title: Parent-teacher meeting
body: A parent-teacher meeting will be held on {date:+8} between 9:00 AM and 12:00 noon in your child's classroom.
Class teachers will share your child's progress, attendance and notebooks. Please bring the school diary with you.
There are no regular classes on that day. Students may come with their parents in school uniform.
